summary: All three recoverable author-reported directions matched the registered day-25 whole-hypothalamus contrast: Lcn2 and Lrg1 increased in CT-26 cachectic mice, and Fabp7 decreased. The labelled Lrg1 point was approximately +4.5 log2 fold change, compared with +4.41 in the registered table. This selected-gene comparison falls below the 30-pair concordance minimum. [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1152/ajpcell.00319.2025) · [Supplemental Figure S4C](https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.30071641.v5)
openIssues: The accessible Figure 1E text named two of its ten genes. The original graphic and its underlying values were unavailable through the reviewed routes.
The full hypothalamus DESeq2 table was not located. Exact author coefficients, raw P values, FDR and genome-wide agreement remain unassessed.
